about: The introitus of the formulary “Saint Stephen, the First Martyr” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Princes sat and spoke against me, and the wicked persecuted me; help me, O Lord my God, for Your servant was occupied with Your ordinances. Blessed are the spotless in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
